authority_if_any_v8_gate_fails.required_next_action: Freeze the first V8 result. Any changed grammar, query order, parser, name-key semantics, team equivalence, tiebreak, target selection, source, timeout, retry behavior, gate, or threshold requires a new preregistered version.

conditional_capability_evidence.ari_az_team_alias_qualified_only_if: Every V8 gate passes, all four ARI stress targets resolve, and at least one selected candidate uses NGS AZ.
conditional_capability_evidence.multiple_candidate_tiebreak_qualified_on: Every V8 gate passes and at least one target has >1 primary candidate and the frozen position+jersey tiebreak resolves exactly one valid GSIS.
conditional_capability_evidence.query_fallback_semantics_qualified_only_: Every V8 gate passes and at least one target requires a post-exact executed fallback and resolves.
conditional_capability_evidence.query_grammar_guard_qualified_only_if: Every overall V8 gate passes; all six fresh grammar-stress targets skip invalid exact-visible pre-dispatch, execute source_canonical_name, and resolve uniquely.
conditional_capability_evidence.source_canonical_name_representation_qua: Every V8 gate passes and at least one fresh target executes source_canonical_name and resolves using the canonical name key.

fixed_resolution_rule.candidate_name_match: candidate frozen name_key(displayName) equals target frozen name_key(visible_name) or, when available, target frozen name_key(source_canonical_query_name)
fixed_resolution_rule.multiple_candidate_tiebreak: If >1 primary candidate, require frozen target position plus integer jersey to identify exactly one candidate; otherwise fail closed.
fixed_resolution_rule.single_candidate_rule: Resolve only one primary candidate with gsisId matching ^00-[0-9]{7}$.

governance.next_phase_after_pass: Freeze and durably preserve V8 before any point-in-time availability application. Identity, game-day membership, injury designation, inactive status, and replacement/role consequences remain separate questions.

purpose: Prospective fresh held-out validation of the V7 official-roster-to-NGS GSIS resolver with exactly one query-surface change: before browser dispatch, each preregistered query representation is checked against the first-party NGS term grammar observed in canonical V7. Invalid representations are skipped without request or character rewriting; the next already-preregistered representation may execute. Identity semantics, team equivalence, source-canonical parsing, position+jersey tiebreak, GSIS validation, thresholds, and authority ceiling otherwise remain unchanged.

query_grammar_guard.executed_query_stop_rule: After any executed query, continue only if the response is HTTP 200, parseable, and players length 0. Stop at the first HTTP 200 parseable nonempty players array or any executed transport/parse failure.
query_grammar_guard.qualification_ceiling: May qualify only the bounded pre-dispatch grammar guard if all V8 gates pass and the fresh grammar-stress stratum prospectively exercises it.
query_grammar_guard.rule: Generate the same ordered V7 query representations. Before browser dispatch, test each representation with a full match to the frozen term_pattern. If invalid, record it as skipped_pre_dispatch_query_grammar and issue no request. Continue to the next already-preregistered representation. Do not delete, replace, transliterate, or otherwise rewrite characters.
query_grammar_guard.source: Canonical V7 first-party NGS HTTP-400 response

parser.comma_split: Split canonical_data_name on comma; trim each component; discard empty components; require exactly two nonempty components or canonical representation unavailable.
parser.component_order: First component family name; second component given-name string.
parser.normalization: No nickname table, stemming, token substitution, edit distance, phonetic transform, or manual correction.
parser.suffix_rule: If final whitespace token of given-name string is a frozen suffix token, move that exact token after family name; otherwise emit given-name string + space + family name.

source_canonical_name_rule.semantic_name_keys: Candidate displayName may match under frozen V7 name_key to either visible_name or deterministic source canonical query name.

canonical_name_variant_stratum.rule: Eligible rows with available canonical query name whose frozen name_key differs from visible_name; sort by selection key/team/visible_name/profile_path and take 32.

query_grammar_stress_stratum.rule: All eligible rows whose exact visible_name fails frozen NGS term_pattern while deterministic source canonical query name exists and passes term_pattern.

target_selection.union_rule: Row-identity union of coverage, team_alias_ari, source_name_variant, canonical_name_variant, and query_grammar_stress strata.
